title: ConfluenceScore
description: DecisionAgent's scoring output. See SYSTEM-DESIGN.md section 6. This is a decision-quality measure, not a win-probability estimate. Scoring is normalized against the ENGAGED-dimension maximum (engaged_count x 25), not a flat /100 total -- capping every dimension at a flat 25/100 made STRICT mode's 85 threshold mathematically unreachable with only 3 dimensions engaged (3x25=75 max); see SYSTEM-DESIGN.md section 6.2 for the corrected formula.

mode_locked_at.description: Mode-lock rule: recorded before any dimension is analyzed and immutable for this run -- never downgraded after the fact to force a pass.

engaged_count.description: number of dimensions with eligible=true; denominator for raw_pct is engaged_count x 25

contradictions.description: Anti-cherry-picking rule: this array must include contradictions found in EVERY dimension whose data source is AVAILABLE, not only the engaged/counted dimensions -- an available-but-unused dimension's contradictions still apply their full penalty.

raw_pct.description: (sum of points across engaged dimensions / (engaged_count x 25)) x 100; 0 if engaged_count is 0

penalty_total.description: percentage points, e.g. -15, subtracted from raw_pct -- not raw points

dimension_count_met.description: true only if engaged_count meets the active mode's minimum -- evaluated independently of final_score

unresolved_high_impact_contradictions.description: count of HIGH-impact contradictions still unresolved after Contradiction Analysis; STRICT mode additionally requires this to be 0 (SYSTEM-DESIGN.md section 6.1)

verdict.description: TRADE requires threshold_met AND dimension_count_met AND no blocking event-risk-window contradiction; in STRICT mode also unresolved_high_impact_contradictions == 0

eligible.description: false if data source for this dimension is MOCK/UNAVAILABLE/STALE, or the dimension wasn't used
